title: Parse YAML — yaml_parse
text: x length-one character vector containing YAML, raw vector UTF-8 YAML bytes. simplify TRUE, sequences whose elements scalars type collapse atomic vector. default FALSE, shape result never depends contents document. aliases treat YAML aliases. "resolve" (default) replaces alias value target; node identity preserved. "error" rejects document containing alias. big_integers represent integers large R numeric type hold exactly (beyond 2^53). "bigint" (default) returns zuyaml_bigint character vector holding decimal value, "double" explicit opt-lossy conversion, "error" refuses document. package never loses integer precision silently. tags treat application tag !duration. Core schema tags (!!str, !!int, !!float, !!bool, !!null) always override resolution, !!str 12 string "12". "ignore" (default) converts tagged value though untagged; "error" rejects document. Ignoring default rejecting refuse great deal ordinary YAML. duplicate_keys FALSE (default), mapping duplicate keys error. TRUE, duplicates become duplicate names resulting list. max_depth Maximum nesting depth, 0 unlimited. max_size Maximum input size bytes, 0 unlimited. max_nodes Maximum number R values materialised, 0 unlimited. limit bounds alias expansion: billion-laughs document small shallow, neither max_size max_depth constrains . default leaves roughly fifty times headroom large document needs. path Optional file path, used make error messages informative. yaml_read() companions set .
